questions.question: The pituitary gland is derived embryologically from:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. Oral ectoderm and neuroectoderm

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. Somatotrophs and lactotrophs

questions.question: A patient with excessive prolactin secretion most likely has a tumor arising from:

options: Both are derived from oral ectoderm
The posterior pituitary contains axons of hypothalamic neurons

questions.explanation: Correct answer: C. The posterior pituitary contains axons of hypothalamic neurons

questions.question: Herring bodies are components of pars nervosa, what is the nature of herrings bodies?
options: Secretory granules stored in axon terminals
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. Secretory granules stored in axon terminals

questions.question: Which of the following criteria truly describe Chromophobes?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. Degranulated or undifferentiated cells
